svg.text: The piece is a chain of three rise-and-fall civilizations, each one collapsing into the birth of the next, ending
in a debate that forks and converges on how to name what happened.

g.text: Time runs down the page through three color-coded civilizations, each dying into the next, before the story opens into
a forked reflection that converges on one question of language.

g.text: Three ways to hide a cheat
Two simultaneous problems drive three parallel workstreams, each producing a partial, telling result, and all three
funnel into the turn toward Hugging Face.
